mina (People Ops): Quick heads-upwe're getting reports that panel reminder emails include a scorecard link that 404s for external contractors. Noticed in two hires yesterday.
bryce (Hiring Ops): I saw that for contractor candidate 7201. The invite has /scorecard/external/ but clicking gives 404. Internal users fine.
felix (Recruiter Eng): thanks. Can you paste a failing URL?
anya (Recruiter): example: https://ats.redwood.example/scorecard/external/7201/review
felix (Recruiter Eng): looking at logs: requests to /scorecard/external/* hit the feature-gating proxy which expects a config flag `allow_external_scorecards` per tenant. That flag was accidentally set to false in yesterday's config sync.
webhook-bot: config-sync:tenant-flags rolled at 2234550000 by infra-bot.
bryce (Hiring Ops): contractors often use a different auth flow; can't interrupt them with sign-in loops. We need a patch or a fallback now.
felix (Recruiter Eng): quick mitigation: rewrite inbound links in the outbound email template to the internal path /scorecard/shared/7201 which bypasses the gating proxy and respects short-lived tokens. I can patch the template in the transactional-email service in ~20m. Any objections?
mina (People Ops): do it. Also flag impacted candidate IDs so we can proactively message contractors.
anya (Recruiter): +1. I'll pull the list from yesterday and prepare a message for external reviewers.
felix (Recruiter Eng): note: will add metric `scorecard.link.failures.external` capturing candidate_id + tenant_id (no PII). Plan: 1) patch email template to /scorecard/shared/..., 2) backfill links for sent emails that failed (small script), 3) revert proxy flag after we add explicit allowlist.
bryce (Hiring Ops): for the backfill, can we send an updated email rather than modify the old one? Some contractors ignore repeated emails.
mina (People Ops): yes, send an updated email with subject prefix "[Updated link]" so it stands out. I'll approve copy.
felix (Recruiter Eng): deploying template change now. Will post timestamp.
webhook-bot: deploy:txn-email-scorecard-fallback v0.2 started at 2234567905 by infra-bot.
felix (Recruiter Eng): deployed at 2234567970. Patch active. Running a quick smoke for 7201 now.
anya (Recruiter): I clicked the updated link in the test invite and it resolves. Thank you.
bryce (Hiring Ops): can you also ensure tokens in /scorecard/shared/ are valid for 48h? Contractors sometimes take longer to respond.
felix (Recruiter Eng): default token TTL is 24h; I can extend to 48h for `external` cohort via config change. I'll do that as part of follow-up.
mina (People Ops): please post a short template for the updated email here so I can send to the impacted contractors.
anya (Recruiter): draft: "Hi — we've updated the reviewer link for candidate <ID>. Please use the new link to submit your feedback. Reach out if you still can't access it."
mina (People Ops): perfect. Sending outreach now.
felix (Recruiter Eng): added metric and scheduled config change for TTL to 48h at 2234569000. Will also open a small ticket to audit other gated paths.
bryce (Hiring Ops): thanks everyone. Can we also add a unit test that simulates external tenant requests to avoid breaking this again?
felix (Recruiter Eng): yes adding test to transactional-email CI and proxy integration tests.
mina (People Ops): closing loop: updated emails sent at 2234568045. Please ping here if any contractors still report issues. Thanks team!
